column1: # Families whose load components can never be refunded: reverting a crystal armour piece or the
#   crystal shield keeps the seeds but always loses the loaded charges, so crystal shards used on
#   the piece book as a counted Supplies spend at load instead of a neutral charge transfer
#   (owner 2026-10-12). The ring of suffering follows the same law (a discharge never refunds its
#   stored rings of recoil), and so does the bracelet of ethereum (an uncharge destroys the stored
#   ether) (OSRS Wiki, owner 2026-10-12). These families keep no Check comparison; a corrupted
#   weapon is a different item id and stays untracked. Keyed by charged_items.tsv.
